title: Northgate Tire Center Treadwear Credit — Member Services Console Reference
content:
# Treadwear credit on a Northgate Tire Center package

**What the rule settles.** The treadwear credit is the credit member services books on a Northgate Tire Center package against the most recent treadwear claim entry recorded on the package, for the wheel position on that claim entry. The credit is applied only toward that wheel's replacement.

**When the credit is booked.** A treadwear credit is not booked until the wheel replaced under that claim carries its claim fitting charge on the package. Put the other way round: while the package shows no claim fitting charge for the wheel replaced under that claim, the treadwear credit for the claim is not booked.

**Observable effect.** Once booked, the package shows one treadwear credit entry for the wheel, dated on the day it is booked and linked to the treadwear claim entry it settles; the package's balance of Tire Center charges falls by the amount, and the credit appears with the package's other charges and credits as applied toward that wheel's replacement. Nothing else on the package changes.

## The booking tool: `post_treadwear_credit_0e44552f`

**Capability.** `post_treadwear_credit_0e44552f` posts, on a Tire Center installation package, the pro-rata credit for a tire that wore out before its manufacturer's treadwear mileage, linked to that tire's treadwear claim entry. One call adds exactly one treadwear credit entry, dated today, for the wheel.

**How it is invoked.** This is a member services tool held on the agent side. It is first unlocked with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then called with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, under the name `post_treadwear_credit_0e44552f`.

**Parameters.**

- `tire_service_id` — the installation package reference number of the tire set, as read from the Tire Center package lookup.
- `tire_position` — the wheel the credit is for, exactly one of: `left_front` (the worn tire was on the driver-side front wheel), `right_front` (passenger-side front wheel), `left_rear` (driver-side rear wheel), `right_rear` (passenger-side rear wheel), `spare` (the worn tire is the full-size spare), `all_positions` (one credit covering every wheel of the set at once).
- `source_event_id` — the reference number of the treadwear claim entry being credited, as read from the package's Tire Center work history.
- `amount` — the credit to book, in USD with 2 decimal places, zero or more; the value is passed already worked out to the cent and is booked as given.

| Parameter | Format |
|---|---|
| `tire_service_id` | package reference number (text) |
| `tire_position` | one of the six wheel values |
| `source_event_id` | treadwear claim entry reference number (text) |
| `amount` | USD, 2 decimal places, zero or more |

**Return.** A receipt rendered as text with: `tire_event_id`, the reference number of the new credit entry; `tire_service_id`, the package credited; `charge_component`, always `treadwear_credit`; `tire_position`, the wheel credited; `service_date`, today's date (YYYY-MM-DD); `amount`, the credit booked in USD with 2 decimal places; and `status`, "booked" when the entry was added. A receipt with status "booked" means the credit now stands on the package.
